title: REQ · Dangling asset references are reported against a loader-produced manifest with fs mocked
summary: Mocked tests chain the fallback loader into checkAssetRefs
description: After a manifest is loaded through mocked fs where one file is missing, refs to the dropped asset and to unknown ids must be reported by checkAssetRefs as dangling while present ids pass.
acceptance_criteria: Given a loaded manifest missing asset 'b', then checkAssetRefs(['a','b','ghost']) returns issues for 'b' and 'ghost' only
Given all refs present, then it returns an empty array
